def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    # Drop rows with missing sex (unknown sex per rules)
    df = df.dropna(subset=['sex'])
    # Drop rows with missing body_mass_g
    df = df.dropna(subset=['body_mass_g'])
    result = df.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in result.items()}
